data.name: Ashwood Biochar
data.description: Ashwood Biochar is a Lexington, Kentucky producer of wood-based biochar made from sustainable woody biomass waste using gasification/pyrolysis technology. Products include raw biochar, pellets, and blends sold as soil amendments, and the company runs a Cover Crops & Carbon Assistance Program paying farmers $100–$300 per acre to adopt biochar practices. It is affiliated with Ashwood Trinity/Ashwood Energy Partners.
